newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 INDEX CLOSES UNCHANGED AT 559.8.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 INDEX CLOSES UNCHANGED AT 559.8.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Czech shares close Thursday's Prague Stock Exchange session mixed, leaving the index steady from Wednesday.
*CEZ, Komercni Banka edge higher, SPT Telecom dips.
*Overall, 215 issues rise, 212 lose ground, and 89 hold steady.
*Total volume 1.13 million shares on turnover of 1.16 billion crowns.
